outcome: platinum concentrations in umbilical cord blood
cohort: 21 pregnant women diagnosed with cervical cancer in the second trimester between May 2008 and June 2014, who received platinum-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy
finding: Platinum concentrations in umbilical cord blood and amniotic fluid were lower than in maternal blood, suggesting a placental barrier effect.
gest_age: Mean 17 weeks (range 13-23) at diagnosis, deliveries between 30.4 and 36.5 weeks of gestation
